Faq.title: <highlight>Questions</highlight> about the project
Faq.storyTitle: Why is the site called Feridinha?
Faq.storyBody1: The <site>Feridinha.com</site> website was created by developer <author>@Feridinha</author> in 2021, which is why it has that name.
Faq.storyBody2: The initial goal was to provide a stable upload website, since Imgur and Inuuls kept going offline at the time. Over time, the community of streamer <ghiletofar>@ghiletofar</ghiletofar> supported the project, and it consequently spread to other Brazilian communities.
Faq.storyBody3: Over the years, FeridinhaSync emerged, reaching even more communities. Every project under the Feridinha™ name was created without any financial interest and will always be free for everyone.
Faq.storyBody4: However, if you would like to support it directly, you can make a donation via PIX here
Faq.contactTitle: How can I get in touch?
Faq.contactBody: You can message me on Discord (<discord>@Feridinha</discord>), Twitter (<twitter>@FeridinhaDev</twitter>) (<email>faq@feridinha.com</email>)
Faq.supportTitle: How can I support the project?
Faq.supportBody: If you would like to support the project directly, you can make a donation via PIX here
Faq.deletedTitle: I deleted a file. Why hasn't it disappeared yet?
Faq.deletedBody1: When you upload a file, a cache is created automatically. This cache can take from 2 minutes to 2 hours to update, depending on the site's traffic.
Faq.deletedBody2: With the new version of the site, this cache is cleared automatically, although it may still persist for a few minutes.
Faq.deletedBody3: If you uploaded a personal file and need it deleted <urgent>URGENTLY</urgent>, message me on Discord: <discord>@Feridinha</discord>
Faq.reportTitle: How do I report a file that violates the Terms of Use?
Faq.reportBody: If you have found a file that does not comply with the site's Terms of Use (TOS), email me at <email>tos@feridinha.com</email> or contact me directly through <discord>Discord</discord>.

ugc.title: User-generated content
ugc.body: You are responsible for the content you upload. Feridinha only hosts this material and does not automatically endorse published content.

opinions.title: Author opinions
opinions.body: Submitted content reflects only the opinion of the author.

prohibited.title: Prohibited content
prohibited.body: Uploading malware, viruses, doxxing, illegal pornography, copyright-infringing material, unauthorized exposure of private data or any other illegal or harmful content is prohibited.

reports.title: Reports
reports.body: To report violations, send an email to <email>tos@feridinha.com</email> or use the public contacts listed on the <faq>FAQ</faq> page.

review.title: Content review
review.body: Content is only manually reviewed when reported. We may remove or block material that violates these terms.

commercial.title: Commercial use
commercial.body: Commercial use by third parties requires prior approval.

termination.title: Termination
termination.body: We may terminate or restrict access to the service at any time in cases of abuse, rule violations or operational need.

collection.title: Data collection
collection.body: We collect minimal operational data, including IP and User-Agent.

usage.title: Use of data
usage.body: This data is used for security, abuse prevention and identification of parties responsible for content that violates the terms.

sharing.title: Data sharing
sharing.body: We do not share your data with third parties except when necessary to comply with legal obligations.

security.title: Security
security.body: We adopt reasonable measures to protect data against unauthorized access.

rights.title: User rights
rights.body: You may request information about your data and request deletion when applicable.
